mapper.select: SELECT r.RESULT_ID, r.TASK_ID, r.ASSET_ID, r.BOOK_QUANTITY, r.ACTUAL_QUANTITY, r.DIFFERENCE_QUANTITY, r.INVENTORY_RESULT, r.LOCATION, r.INVENTORY_DATE, r.INVENTORY_PERSON, r.HANDLE_STATUS, r.HANDLE_REMARK, r.TENANT_ID, r.CREATE_BY, r.CREATE_TIME, r.UPDATE_BY, r.UPDATE_TIME, r.IS_DELETED, a.ASSET_CODE AS assetCode, a.ASSET_NAME AS assetName FROM TBL_FIXED_ASSET_INVENTORY_RESULT r LEFT JOIN TBL_FIXED_ASSET_CARD a ON r.ASSET_ID = a.ASSET_ID AND a.IS_DELETED = 0 WHERE r.TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND r.IS_DELETED = 0 ORDER BY r.INVENTORY_DATE DESC, r.CREATE_TIME DESC

SELECT r.RESULT_ID, r.TASK_ID, r.ASSET_ID, r.BOOK_QUANTITY, r.ACTUAL_QUANTITY, r.DIFFERENCE_QUANTITY, r.INVENTORY_RESULT, r.LOCATION, r.INVENTORY_DATE, r.INVENTORY_PERSON, r.HANDLE_STATUS, r.HANDLE_REMARK, r.TENANT_ID, r.CREATE_BY, r.CREATE_TIME, r.UPDATE_BY, r.UPDATE_TIME, r.IS_DELETED, a.ASSET_CODE AS assetCode, a.ASSET_NAME AS assetName FROM TBL_FIXED_ASSET_INVENTORY_RESULT r LEFT JOIN TBL_FIXED_ASSET_CARD a ON r.ASSET_ID = a.ASSET_ID AND a.IS_DELETED = 0 WHERE r.TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND r.DIFFERENCE_QUANTITY != 0 AND r.IS_DELETED = 0 ORDER BY ABS(r.DIFFERENCE_QUANTITY) DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_FIXED_ASSET_INVENTORY_RESULT SET HANDLE_STATUS = #{handleStatus}, HANDLE_REMARK = #{handleRemark}, UPDATE_BY = #{updateBy}, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE RESULT_ID = #{resultId}
